name: Silent reveal (no hook text, plug-in → wow)
status: EXPERIMENT. Huge external numbers (23.7M and 8.0M, both organic), but 63/63 of our FB reels had text at 0 s, so there is zero internal evidence. Max 1 test per decor/pet product per week.
summary: No on-screen text at all. The first frame is a hand plugging in or switching on the product, and the transformation lands by ~4 s. It only works when the effect explains itself visually.
why: sarvina450 silent plug-in projector, AIWFCIY, 12.14 s: 23.7M / 175.5K shares (no paid flag); a second reel did 2.5M (X).
pet.scanner.pk kitten in a carrier pouch, no text, 13 cuts: 8.0M / 98.3K shares (X).
Contradiction with our house rule: all 63 FB reels had hook text at 0.0 s (hooks REPORT §3). That is why this is Tier C.

product_fit.type: Decor with a dramatic visual effect (projector, animated lights)

product_fit.evidence: the only wearable example (neilaswgza6 5.5M) is paid-flagged

shots.content: hand plugs the product into a wall socket in a dark room; first light by 2 s

measured: pet.scanner 8.0M: 13 cuts in 15.54 s (~1.2 s shots).
rules: The effect must explain itself with the sound off.

text.style: No text. A/B it against the same body carrying the decor then-vs-now text.

generations.title: Plug-in in the dark
generations.inputs: <<<image_1>>> product; reference video of the real effect
generations.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 iPhone video in a dark bedroom at night. Close on a wall socket: a hand plugs in the {product} from <<<image_1>>>, and at two seconds it switches on and the first light of exactly the effect in the reference video spreads across the ceiling. Locked camera. Natural sound only: plug click, a soft hum. No music, no text. The effect is only what the real product does.
A small American flag is visible in the background.

shot on iphone 12, no warm lighting, no blur, nothing cinematic, make it look as organic as possible, remove the caption and the emojis. when recreating do not make the video grainy or sharp in any way, remake it as if it was freshly refilmed 4k iphone 12 footage.

generations.title: WOW 1 | WOW 2
generations.prompt:
Two shots in one 4-second vertical 9:16 clip joined by a STRAIGHT HARD CUT, no fade, natural real-time speed, handheld phone look, the same dark bedroom, the {product} switched on. SHOT 2 (2.0-4.0s), new angle: low angle: a child in pajamas sits up in bed looking up, mouth open. The effect matches the reference video exactly; nothing glows beyond the surfaces it really lights. Audio: soft hum, a child's gasp. No background music, no text, no captions.
A small American flag is visible in the background.

variants.name: Text A/B
variants.rule: Post the same render twice on different days: once silent, once with then-vs-now text (re-render the hook so the files differ).
variants.gate: If silent ≥ text on 2 of 3 pairs, promote to Tier B.

checks.rule: no OCR text in any frame

open: TikTok plays ≠ FB views (cross-platform swings up to 500×, external REPORT §1).
